Healthy.organic_treatment: Apply Neem cake to soil periodically to maintain plant immunity.
Healthy.cultural_practices: Ensure proper spacing between vines to promote ventilation and sunlight.
Healthy.preventive_measures: Monitor crop weekly for early signs of fungal or bacterial infection.

Mild.organic_treatment: Foliar spray of 1% Trichoderma harzianum solution.
Mild.cultural_practices: Remove yellowing lower leaves touching the soil.
Mild.preventive_measures: Avoid overhead watering during humid evenings.

Moderate.organic_treatment: Sprinkle wood ash around vine base to reduce moisture build-up.
Moderate.cultural_practices: Adjust shade netting to reduce sunburn or water pooling.
Moderate.preventive_measures: Maintain clean drainage channels in the field.

Severe.organic_treatment: Apply balanced organic compost and Bio-fertilizer.
Severe.cultural_practices: Inspect vine roots for waterlogging or soil compaction.
Severe.preventive_measures: Ensure proper drainage during heavy rain seasons.

Healthy.cultural_practices: Improve soil drainage in the bareja (betel conservatory).
Healthy.preventive_measures: Use disease-free vine cuttings for propagation.

Mild.status: Mild Leaf Rot Infection (< 15% surface area)
Mild.chemical_treatment: Spray Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2g/liter of water.
Mild.organic_treatment: Foliar application of Neem leaf extract (5%) mixed with garlic slurry.
Mild.cultural_practices: Prune and destroy infected leaves immediately away from the field.
Mild.preventive_measures: Disinfect pruning tools with 70% alcohol before reuse.

Moderate.status: Moderate Leaf Rot Infection (15% - 40% surface area)
Moderate.chemical_treatment: Drench vine base with Bordeaux mixture (1%) and spray Carbendazim @ 1g/liter.
Moderate.organic_treatment: Soil application of Trichoderma viride enriched farmyard manure.
Moderate.cultural_practices: Reduce irrigation frequency and allow soil surface to dry out.
Moderate.preventive_measures: Isolate affected vine rows to prevent canopy-to-canopy spread.

Severe.status: Severe Leaf Rot Outbreak (> 40% surface area)
Severe.chemical_treatment: Systemic application of Fosetyl-Al (0.2%) combined with Streptocycline (100 ppm).
Severe.organic_treatment: Uproot heavily rotting vines and solarize soil with transparent polythene.
Severe.cultural_practices: Uproot and burn severely decayed vines to protect adjacent healthy plants.
Severe.preventive_measures: Re-plant bareja with certified disease-resistant cuttings after soil treatment.

Healthy.cultural_practices: Ensure proper air circulation by thinning overcrowded foliage.

Mild.status: Mild Leaf Spot Infection (< 15% surface area)
Mild.organic_treatment: Spray cow dung slurry filtrate (10%) mixed with turmeric powder.
Mild.cultural_practices: Remove spotted leaves before fungal spores spread across rows.
Mild.preventive_measures: Water crops at the ground level, avoiding leaf wetness.

Moderate.status: Moderate Leaf Spot Infection (15% - 40% surface area)
Moderate.chemical_treatment: Alternate spray of Difenoconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/liter and Copper Oxychloride @ 2.5g/liter.
Moderate.organic_treatment: Apply fermented buttermilk + garlic spray every 7 days.
Moderate.cultural_practices: Increase vine tying height to improve lower canopy ventilation.
Moderate.preventive_measures: Destroy crop residues surrounding the betel garden.

Severe.status: Severe Leaf Spot Blight (> 40% surface area)
Severe.chemical_treatment: Combination spray of Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1ml/liter + Streptocycline @ 0.1g/liter.
Severe.organic_treatment: Heavy foliar application of Bio-fungicide (Trichoderma + Pseudomonas mixture).
Severe.cultural_practices: Strip affected foliage thoroughly and dispose of via deep burial.
Severe.preventive_measures: Enforce strict quarantine of affected garden sections.
